node: Transmission-line hardware, conductor fittings, clamps, spacers, dead-ends, vibration dampers, and line accessories
summary: Layer 1B expansion found one unusually direct US-listed underfollowed candidate, Preformed Line Products, plus three adjacent/reference or second-order public-market mappings. The strongest direct fit is PLPC because filings and product positioning tie it to overhead/underground energy and communications networks, and recent reported backlog growth supports the possibility that grid and communications infrastructure demand is flowing through the hardware layer. Hubbell is the key reference incumbent for line construction, connectors, dead-ends and utility hardware, but it is a larger, higher-attention electrical OEM. Valmont and AZZ are less direct: they map to transmission structures, substation components, galvanizing/corrosion protection, and utility steel fabrication capacity rather than conductor fittings themselves. MacLean Power Systems appears highly relevant operationally but is private, so it is evidence for industry structure rather than a US-listed candidate.
